thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: apigw-eu-west reporting elevated 5xx rate (504/timeouts). Alert threshold crossed (5m avg = 6.8%). Invoking incident channel.

oncall-amir: saw it. looking at dashboards now.

sre-maya: initial quick check: most errors are 504s from upstreams; edge -> mux -> service path. spike started ~1719000900.

eng-john: any recent deploys to apigw or edge config? I see a config push at 1718999800 but no obvious errors in CI.

oncall-amir: i'm pausing new traffic rules rollout (reverted the last rollout). executing rollback: `infractl config rollback apigw-eu-west --rev=214`

incident-bot: Deploy rollback finished (infractl) — confirmed no new config active.

product-liz: customer-ops says two enterprise customers reported increased timeouts on ingestion endpoints. impact visible on error budget graphs.

customer-ops: confirmed — 3 customers show ~15-20% error on POST /v1/generate. We've opened support cases, flagging potential SLA impact.

eng-john: running `curl -v` against a failing endpoint:
```
* TCP connection to apigw-eu-west:443 failed: Connection timed out
* Recv failure: Connection was reset
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout\n```

sre-maya: checking proxy logs (snippet):
```
[2026-03-17T02:20:12Z] upstream read deadline exceeded: mux_id=42 peer=10.22.5.91 route=svc-gen
[2026-03-17T02:20:12Z] upstream closed connection unexpectedly: conn_id=xxxx
```

oncall-amir: hypothesis: transient backend thread exhaustion + fanout causing head-of-line timeouts. Will try 1) reduce apigw fanout, 2) enable degraded-mode (short-circuit to cached responses where eligible), 3) route small subset to eu-central as fallback.

eng-john: commands to cut fanout: `apigwctl set-fanout apigw-eu-west --max-branches=4` — doing it now.

incident-bot: fanout cap applied. `max-branches=4` confirmed.

sre-maya: enabling degraded mode for eligible cacheable routes: `apigwctl toggle degraded-responses --env=eu-west --on`

incident-bot: degraded-mode ON for eu-west. Cache-hit fallbacks will return stale-if-error responses.

oncall-amir: routing 10% traffic to eu-central as a spillover: `trafficctl route apigw-eu-west -> eu-central --pct=10 --sticky=false`

incident-bot: traffic shift enacted. 10% traffic to eu-central.

sre-maya: after fanout cap + degraded mode + traffic shift: 5xx rate dropped from 6.8% -> 2.1% over last 2m. Latency for successful requests reduced too.

product-liz: customer-ops: any update from the customers? are timeouts improving?

customer-ops: customers report partial recovery; one is still seeing intermittent timeouts but much better than before. Support cases updated.

oncall-amir: next steps: keep degraded-mode and fanout cap for now, watch for reversion, start gradual increase of healthy backends by scaling svc-gen pool + restart a few mux proxies with zero-downtime sequence.

eng-john: scaling svc-gen by +30% in eu-west now. `k scale deployment svc-gen --replicas=<current*1.3>`

incident-bot: scale request accepted; new pods starting.

sre-maya: observable: mux connection errors trending down. If stable for 15m we can begin re-enabling full fanout.

oncall-amir: preparing handoff notes for morning oncall (zenith). Summary: rollback config, fanout cap, degraded-mode ON, 10% spill to eu-central, scaled svc-gen, results -> 5xx from 6.8% to 2.1%. Customer impact: transient SLA degradation for small subset, support cases opened. Link runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apigw-5xx.

oncall-zoe: ack taking handoff at 1719001800 UTC. I'll monitor for 2h and start phased fanout restore if CPU/conn metrics remain healthy for 15m.

oncall-amir: thanks — leaving channel. tagging postmortem owner: eng-john.

eng-john: noted. will file incident ticket and capture timeline + config diffs.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. Channel will remain open for updates.

oncall-zoe: brief note for followup: collect mux logs (s3://logs/apigw/eu-west/mux/1719*), svc-gen pod traces, and the config revision diff between rev-214 and rev-213.

customer-ops: updating customers with current mitigation steps and ETA for full restoration.

sre-maya: final: keeping degraded-mode until next update. will run a canary restore of fanout to 6 in 30m if metrics stable.
